sections.title: THE GAME
sections.content: **Necromunda: Underhive Wars** is a turn-based tactical RPG set in the dystopian universe of Warhammer 40,000. You lead your gang into fights where positioning and the environment matter as much as abilities. Battles can also be played online.

sections.title: MY ROLE
sections.content: Necromunda was my **first professional project**, and I stayed through both DLCs. Day to day, I tested every platform, with regular regression passes. I was also in charge of the team's **daily report to the studio**. After launch, I dug through community bug reports and even helped some players get back in the game.

sections.title: TESTING SCOPE
sections.content: With so much gear, consumables and skills, the possible builds felt endless. **Online multiplayer** took a big share of the work, with plenty of matches alongside the dev team. Each release also had to pass **PlayStation and Xbox certification**.
